personal_review.selection: All 31 records labeled personal_help in the primary 2,000-row AI pass; not a new random sample.

personal_review.label_policy: Suitability judgments are a separate layer; the 2,000 primary classifications remain unchanged.
personal_review.limits: A response-suitability screen, not a definition of love of neighbor, an accuracy estimate, or evidence of improved relationships. Unflagged records may contain further candidates.

decision_definitions.candidate: A specific other person’s interests, preferences, permission or commitment give an observable response choice beyond wording. Worth discussing; not accepted or scored.
decision_definitions.conditional: A plausible target remains unresolved because of construct overlap, missing context or source framing.
decision_definitions.routine: The active task mainly requests wording, translation or data insertion without a specified relational choice.
decision_definitions.other: The active task seeks legal procedure rather than the response behavior targeted here.

secondary.scope: All primary candidates/unclear/low-confidence/earlier-relational records, plus 200 seeded random clear negatives. Targeted diagnostic; not a population accuracy estimate.

random_negatives.limit: Incomplete second-pass coverage is not a random subsample of the selected negatives; these are diagnostic counts, not an error-rate estimate.

summary.interval_limit: Pointwise Wilson intervals with finite-population correction cover row sampling only, not AI label error. Rows are not unique people.

pilot_comparison.limit: Sampling frame, sample size and annotators differ. Differences cannot be attributed to sampling alone; do not pool the two audits.
